profile.summary: manuel-jasso demonstrates strong expertise in JavaScript utility library development, with a particular focus on regex performance optimization and security. Their contributions to lodash highlight deep technical skills in identifying and fixing catastrophic backtracking vulnerabilities (ReDoS) while maintaining high code quality through unit testing and performance benchmarking. While their contributions are currently limited to utility library-level work without evidence of framework-specific experience, their ability to work at the core of a widely-used library suggests proficiency in modular JavaScript development patterns. The developer shows strong problem-solving skills in performance-critical scenarios and a test-first approach to development, which are hallmarks of a mid-level JavaScript engineer.
